versions.changelog:
Initial release of 智能竞品监控周报 (competitor-monitor-weekly):

- Automates weekly competitor monitoring with data collection, trend analysis, and report generation.
- Integrates multi-platform scraping, news search, OCR, content summarization, and automated report distribution via channels like Feishu and email.
- Supports scheduled (cron) and manual report generation triggers.
- Provides structured Markdown reports highlighting key competitor activities and actionable recommendations.
- Includes self-optimization to improve monitoring strategies over time.
